rubric.why: The definition identifies the path followed by the moving body.
rubric.description: Defines circular motion as motion along a circular path.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the body moves along a circular path.

rubric.why: A valid example shows an application of circular motion.
rubric.description: Gives one suitable example of circular motion.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for an example such as the hands of a clock moving in circular motion.

modelAnswer: Circular motion is the motion of a body along a circular path.
Example: The hands of a clock move in circular motion.
